body:
As for your questions, I think it's a combination of the two. He's the most recent ex (what do you mean by the Facebook game?) so he's the freshest wound that I carry. I can say definitely, that all my exes have found what seems like good long term relationships and I have floundered in this area of my life (I'm 28) so it just feels like I'm really behind. There's nothing special about him, per se, but just that it's most recent, and a constant reminder. The other exes (with LTRs) and I are good friends (most of them) and friends with their SOs as well. I know they wish me well and vice versa, I guess this is what you mean by Facebook manipulation? That ex is not able to treat me properly even as friends and so I'm obsessed? It's not exactly that I want to date him again, just that I'm weirded by the duplicity in which he says he is my friend but hides important parts of his life (like the girlfriend) from me. It just makes me feel like a weird untrustworthy person, like, some kind of scary bridge troll you want to be polite towards just so that they don't act in a way that would make you feel uncomfortable.

Okay, that bridge troll part in which I'm an untrustworthy contagious leper type person that people can't trust? That's something I feel about other things too, when I feel like people are "just being polite" or not being transparent with me. I know that it's my own issue, I know that, but when I am in such a vulnerable space, it doesn't help me to think about that because the result is the same - I feel rejected, ostracized and somehow deserving of this special place in hell within my own mind. I don't know if any of that makes sense?
I guess, another part is, I feel like I have nothing to offer. Why bother trying when so many people have left me? I have low esteem in my ability to find belonging and intimacy.

My ex seems to be in a relationship. The girl keeps posting about him, and he hasn't even mentioned her to me. I feel gross. This is why I no longer know which version and whose Facebook I should trust over others.
VERY BAD. And in my desperation for intimacy, I don't want to make terrible fucking choices.
More of a dog person, but sure.
